meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration. ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' in any prefix form, any 'ulw' research wording including combined invocations like 'mass ulw research', 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 围绕任意选题派出多路研究者交叉辩论，输出带引用与图表的深度报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果一件事需要顶住不同观点，把证据追到源码并整理成正式报告。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any question into a cited, multi-perspective report with charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need well-sourced analysis weighing opposing views, ending in a polished report.

howto.what: 用户要求研究时，它会先确认交付格式，再组建大型协作团队：按主题分工、设质疑成员互挑错误，持续扩展线索至穷尽，用代码或核查机制验证争议结论，最后产出每条结论均带引用或验证的综合报告，并附图表，经视觉检查和写作校对。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求做研究时触发，例如说出“ulw-research”、“mass ulw research”等词，或要求深度研究/超精确调查；普通提问、调试不会触发。

say.text: ulw-research：请深度调研自动驾驶的安全标准现状。
say.note: 会先确认格式再组建团队开工。

say.text: 做一次hyperdebate式研究：对比三种电池技术的十年前景。
say.note: 会安排红队成员辩论并验证争议点。

say.text: mass ulw research：大范围调查开源社区对AI编程助手的评价。
say.note: 会以大规模并行搜索展开。

howto.what_en: On research request, Claude asks format, builds max team (axis members, skeptics, explore/librarian lanes), EXPAND-loops until leads dry, proves claims by code or claim-graph, delivers cited synthesis with charts, QA'd and proofread.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on explicit research demand: ulw-research, ulw research wording, ultradebate/hyperdebate requests, or explicit deep research / ultra-precise investigation in any language.

say_en.text: ulw-research: deep-dive autonomous driving safety standards.
say_en.note: Asks format, then builds the team.

say_en.text: Run a hyperdebate research on battery tech outlook for 10 years.
say_en.note: Skeptics debate; contested claims get code-verified.

say_en.text: mass ulw research: survey open-source community views on AI coding assistants.
say_en.note: Launches a big parallel collection wave.
